question: What is the cheapest option if I only bill a handful of customers?
expected: Starter, $19/month, up to 50 invoices per month
answer: I could not find the cheapest option for billing a handful of customers in the documentation. Please contact support for assistance.
context:
Ledgerly Plans and Pricing > Billing options

Annual billing gives two months free: you pay for 10 months and use 12. Plan downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period, never mid-cycle.

QuickBooks Integration > What syncs

Customers and invoices sync in both directions every 15 minutes. Payments sync one way, from Ledgerly to QuickBooks. The first sync imports the last 12 months of data and handles up to 10,000 customers.

Refund Policy (current) > How refunds are paid

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. To request a refund, open Billing, choose Request refund, or email billing@ledgerly.example.

Refund Policy (current) > Annual subscriptions

Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, an annual customer who cancels because of a documented outage that breached the uptime SLA receives a prorated account credit for unused full months. Credits are not paid out in cash.

Ledgerly Plans and Pricing

Ledgerly is invoicing and payments software for small businesses. All prices are in USD per month, excluding taxes. Prices can also be shown in EUR or GBP at checkout.

Ledgerly Plans and Pricing > Extra users

Growth accounts can add users for $6 per user per month, up to 15 users in total. Scale accounts can add users for $4 per user per month.

Ledgerly Plans and Pricing > Free trial

Starter and Growth include a 14-day free trial and no credit card is required. The Scale plan trial is available on request through sales.

QuickBooks Integration

Ledgerly connects to QuickBooks Online. QuickBooks Desktop is not supported. Xero and Sage are not supported at this time.

QuickBooks Integration > Taxes and currencies

Tax codes are matched by name. Multi-currency invoices sync only if multi-currency is enabled in QuickBooks.

Refund Policy (current) > Add-on users

Users added in the middle of a billing cycle are not refundable.
